hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: Custom-curve AMM hook that routes all swap volume through Euler lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes using a configurable bonding curve, deposits input tokens into and withdraws output tokens from Euler vaults, and returns the full BeforeSwapDelta to bypass Uniswap v4's concentrated liquidity math. Reverts on direct liquidity additions and donations.
